title: Gift from the Absolute

sources.title: Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen
markers: | description = The {{story|Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen}} is a story item in Baldur's Gate 3.

sources.title: Illithid powers
markers: | description = Illithid powers are special abilities tied to the mind flayer tadpoles infecting the player character, their Origin companions, and some other companions.

summary: Grants one tadpole to spend on an Illithid Power after that skill tree opens.

fields.Inventory behavior: The specimen can remain in inventory before the skill tree unlocks. Once unlocked, collected specimens are credited directly to that skill tree.
fields.Base value: 100 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
